out.detail: upper body injury, will not play against Detroit

away.summary: The Islanders (10-6-5) extended their point streak to six games despite a 4-3 overtime loss to Winnipeg. JG Pageau returned after missing three games with a lower body injury, while Logan Stanley is expected back after missing two games. Defenseman Ryan Pulock will miss this game with an upper body injury, and Alexander Romanov remains out with a torn right ACL.

home.summary: The Red Wings (8-11-3) have won just one of their last seven games and are 3-7-0 in their last 10. They remain without Dylan Larkin, who was suspended by the team without pay on Oct. 29 after requesting a trade. Albert Johansson will return after missing 11 games with an undisclosed injury, while William Wallinder is a game-time decision.
